name: WireMock Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source HTTP API mocking and stubbing server, available as standalone Java JAR, Docker container or library; no software request or project quotas.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only: server compute, storage and networking may cost money. WireMock Cloud hosted mocking and enterprise features are separate offerings; no hosted cloud allowance is included.
